dedupe_keys.name: avoiding avalanches effective dispatch planning for competing storage units in day ahead electricity market simulations

description: Christoph Schimeczek and colleagues at DLR report an AMIRIS electricity-market study of dispatch strategies for competing storage units. A dynamic-programming algorithm compares profit maximisation and system-cost minimisation with different awareness of the price impacts of storage. The related conference description identifies a German 2019 backtest, aggregated storage and 18 separate units, followed by a scenario with 20 GW added storage. The paper reports better historical dispatch agreement under cost minimisation and better price agreement under profit maximisation. These are model comparisons, not evidence that operators adopted the simulated strategies. Zenodo supplies the paper freely under CC BY 4.0, with separate source-linked data and model deposits. Coverage is the German electricity market. The existing AMIRIS record represents the simulation model. A limitation is that numerical files and article bodies were not inspected and the correlations were not independently reproduced.
